card.name: Words just before dose terms in toxicity
card.fires_on: Small words like "the", a comma, or a space before a number, placed where the next word is likely "dose" or "dosage". Seen in animal toxicity and trial-phase text.

modes.label: Animal toxicity studies
modes.description: "the" or a space before a mg/kg figure in lethal-dose or animal-species passages.
